title: The symmetric profiled cat has leading negative defect but the same profiled coefficient

cat_coefficient.point_law: At each point the cat is the equal mixture N(+h_N,v_N) and N(-h_N,v_N), with mean zero, variance v_N+h_N^2 and fourth central moment h_N^4+6h_N^2v_N+3v_N^2.
cat_coefficient.negative_defect: Relative to its moment-matched Gaussian the fourth-cumulant defect is exactly -2h_N^4=-Theta_g(N^4), so the cat lies outside K1577's nonnegative-defect class.
cat_coefficient.interaction_identity: The Wick quartic is even and expectation is linear in the law, so the cat interaction expectation equals that of either sign-reflected profiled Gaussian exactly.
cat_coefficient.energy_sandwich: If lambda_N^prof is the component energy, then lambda_N^prof-(1/4)sqrt(omega_0^2+kappa_(g,N)^+)<=Q_N^cat<=lambda_N^prof.
cat_coefficient.coefficient: Therefore Q_N^cat/N^4->h_g^prof. The cat can improve the profiled value by at most O_g(N), far below K1587's Theta_g(N^(5/2)) residual Ritz descent.
cat_coefficient.route_consequence: A leading negative moment defect alone does not imply a leading coefficient change. Any coefficient-changing construction must use a different multimodal, higher-chaos, nonstationary or spatially structured mechanism, or a global theorem must exclude those mechanisms.
cat_coefficient.scope_guard: This is a coefficient-rigidity theorem for one exact nonperturbative cat family, not the unrestricted ground-energy coefficient or bounded-error recentering.
